info.name: SCTS Institute API
info.description:
Import this file in Postman (Import → File). Then import an environment from the same `postman/` folder and select it in the top-right.

**Dynamic base URL:** every request uses `{{baseUrl}}`. Change `baseUrl` in the active environment (local vs staging vs production) without editing requests.

**Auth:** set `userEmail` and `userPassword` in the environment, run **Auth → Login**. Tests on that request save `accessToken` and `refreshToken` to the environment. Admin and protected folders send `Authorization: Bearer {{accessToken}}`.

**Uploads / hero slides:** Responses may rewrite `mediaUrl` under `/uploads/` to the canonical `UPLOADS_PUBLIC_ORIGIN` host. Use `{{baseUrl}}` here only for HTTP requests to this API.

**Course price:** All course responses (`/api/v1/courses`, `/api/v1/courses/:slug`, `/api/v1/admin/courses*`, `/api/v1/home/trending-courses`) include a numeric `price` and a friendly `pricing: { amount, isFree, currency, display }` object. For trending courses, `pricing.source` is `"custom"` if the trending row overrides the price, otherwise `"course"`.

request.description: Active trending courses with populated course details. Each item has: `price` (custom override, may be null), `displayPrice` (number actually shown), `isCustomPrice` (bool), `pricing.source` = `"custom" | "course"`, plus the populated `course` (which itself has `price`).

response.name: 200 OK — trending with pricing
response.body:
{
  "success": true,
  "data": [
    {
      "_id": "<trendingRowId>",
      "order": 0,
      "price": 39.99,
      "displayPrice": 39.99,
      "isCustomPrice": true,
      "pricing": {
        "amount": 39.99,
        "isFree": false,
        "currency": "USD",
        "display": "$39.99",
        "source": "custom"
      },
      "course": {
        "_id": "69fb485bebb9f2ee62bb18e4",
        "title": "NURSING ASSISTANCE & CAREGIVER ( NAC )",
        "slug": "nursing-assistance-care-giver",
        "imageUrl": "/uploads/1778363287985-852673391.jpeg",
        "isAvailable": true,
        "price": 50,
        "sessionTime": "10:30AM --  4:00PM",
        "location": "Khobar - Riyadh"
      }
    }
  ],
  "message": null,
  "errors": null
}
